Been quiet lately! Here's a couple experimental mix session notes that I figured I'd seed the sub with. Take from them what you will!

4% FA Pear

5% FA Vanilla Bourbon

1% Fresh Cream

Notes: Not bad. Not as "vanilla-y" as I would have liked it to be, so I might revisit sometime in the future and tinker with it. Definitely pear flavored, kind of prominent - so I might want to take that down a notch. Otherwise, not a bad mix.

2% FA Shade Tobacco

5% FA Vienna Cream

2% FA Liquid Amber

Notes: Also not too shabby, but it tastes a little ... "off." Either Vienna Cream isn't the right taste or the Liquid Amber is making it a bit too sweet, but something isn't quite good enough with this mix to make me want to vape it more than a tank at a time, and sparingly at that. Not throw-away, there might be some promise in the Shade-Cream attempt, but as it is it's simply not good enough to make any more of.

4% FA Lime Cold Pressed

6% FA Coconut

Notes: Freshly mixed, this is nothing but Lime. There's a skim of coconut in the background, but this one needs a decent amount of time to steep. As it does, the Lime calms down and the coconut comes through much more pronounced, making it tasty and simple. I like it, and may even play with adding a vanilla, or going the other way with it and adding a few drops of Koolada to it to give it a nice throat snap. Decent, easy, simple - sometimes the most basic stuff turns out.

5% FA Lemon Sicily

4% FA White Peach

1.5% FA Fresh Cream

Notes: Peach and that's about all. No creaminess, no lemon zing, no anything. Three days later and we're singing the same song - so in this one, I'd recommend cutting the peach amount in half, easily. Maybe a boost to the lemon, but truth be told I don't think the combo works very well.

There you go, four little experiments and my thoughts on them. Remember: It's never a failure, just a learning experience. Enjoy, and until next time!
